description: Set certificate auto-renewal settings in ca.conf on the CA. Takes effect on the next puppetserver (re)start and only affects certificates signed after that.

allow_auto_renewal.description: Whether the CA honors agent certificate renewal requests (certificate-authority.allow-auto-renewal)

auto_renewal_cert_ttl.description: TTL for auto-renewed certificates, e.g. '60d' (certificate-authority.auto-renewal-cert-ttl); omit to keep the packaged value
